label: There exist carriers and one joint interpretation of the old causal frame and new content/consumer…
meaning: One finite interpretation jointly satisfies the old causal background and reductive kind classification, consumer content, a true affection report and an erroneous representation. It reuses MindPhysicalism.reductiveBackground rather than restating its causal consequences as assumptions. No general or empirical physicalism follows, and selectional history is stipulated in a primitive relation.
